quiz.q: Which testimonial is most useful to show new clients?
options: "Our survey was translated into Hausa in four days and the field team said people understood it easily." with name and organisation
quiz.explain: It names the work, a result and who said it, which builds trust with similar clients.

quiz.q: A client says your 35,000 naira package is too expensive. What is the best first response?
options: Offer a smaller scope at a lower price, such as the 18,000 naira package for the 10 most important items.
Do the work and ask them to pay what they like.
Drop to 20,000 for the same work.
quiz.explain: Reducing scope keeps your rate intact while meeting the client's budget.

quiz.q: A monthly package pays 55,000 naira and takes 11 hours. A one-off job paid 60,000 naira for 15 hours. Which earns more per hour?
options: The one-off job, 4,000 naira an hour
The monthly package, 5,000 naira an hour
quiz.explain: 55,000 / 11 = 5,000 an hour; 60,000 / 15 = 4,000 an hour. Repeat work is often faster, so it can pay more per hour.

quiz.q: Hauwa plans 4 pitches a week for 12 weeks and gets 1 reply for every 4 pitches. About how many replies should she expect?
quiz.explain: 4 x 12 = 48 pitches; 48 / 4 = 12 replies.

quiz.q: Your launch project outreach produced 10 pitches, 2 replies and no clients. What should you report?
options: Say you got 2 clients to look better.
Report the real numbers honestly and note what you will change.
quiz.explain: Honest results are valid evidence and show you where to improve. Inventing clients or testimonials is dishonest.

quiz.q: When is the best time to raise your prices first?
options: For new clients, while giving existing clients written notice before any change
quiz.explain: Raising for new clients first, with notice to existing ones, is fair and protects relationships.

options: A salaried job done from home
Running a one-person service business that finds, serves and invoices its own clients
finalQuiz.explain: A freelancer is self-employed and handles every stage of the client cycle, from finding work to getting paid.

finalQuiz.q: Bisi has 25 working hours a week and spends 7 on outreach and admin. How many billable hours does she have in a 4-week month?
finalQuiz.explain: 25 minus 7 = 18 billable hours a week; 18 x 4 = 72 a month.

finalQuiz.q: Which skill should a new freelancer sell first?
options: One she enjoys but nobody asks for
One she is strong at with clear evidence of paying demand
Every skill she has, to reach more people
The one with no competitors at all
finalQuiz.explain: Strong skill plus proven demand is the top-right box of the matrix and the fastest route to paid work.

finalQuiz.q: A "client" asks you to pay 15,000 naira for "onboarding software" before your first paid task. What is this most likely to be?
finalQuiz.explain: Real clients pay you. Requests to pay before working are a classic job scam.

finalQuiz.q: Income target 180,000 naira, business costs 36,000 naira, 54 billable hours a month. What is the minimum hourly rate?
A platform keeps 10 percent. You need 45 dollars to reach you. What should you quote?
finalQuiz.explain: Divide by what you keep: 45 / 0.90 = 50 dollars. Adding 10 percent (49.50) would leave you with only 44.55.

finalQuiz.q: What should a good first pitch message ask for?
options: A small next step, such as a short call or a free 3-item sample
finalQuiz.explain: A tiny yes, like a short call or small sample, is easy to agree to and starts the conversation.

finalQuiz.q: Which item must be in a written scope before work starts?
options: Deliverables, deadline, revisions, exclusions and payment terms
finalQuiz.explain: These items prevent the most common misunderstandings and disputes.

finalQuiz.q: An invoice totals 75,000 naira and the client paid a 25,000 naira deposit. What is the balance due?
You realise on day 3 of 7 that a job will be one day late. When should you tell the client?
options: Today, with the reason, a new date and what they will get meanwhile
finalQuiz.explain: Early warnings with a solution keep trust; silent delays damage it.

finalQuiz.q: A freelancer received 150,000 naira in a month and worked 75 hours in total, 50 of them billable. What was her effective hourly rate?
finalQuiz.explain: Effective rate uses all hours worked: 150,000 / 75 = 2,000 naira.

finalQuiz.q: Which plan step most directly increases income without needing many more pitches?
options: Turning a satisfied one-off client into a monthly package and asking for referrals
Giving every new client a big discount
Trying five new platforms at once
finalQuiz.explain: Repeat work and referrals bring income with far less outreach per naira earned.
